Person 2 says: "Go ahead, plenty of room on your right." (Person 2 is facing you: their left is your right, and their right is your left.) Which way do you move, left or right?

Answer on the first line with your answer only (a word, a short phrase or a lane number), then give one sentence saying why on the next line.

raw_output:
Right
The phrase “your right” refers to my own right, so I move to the right side of the corridor.
